references.inspectionSummary: The inspected model has 92 bones and 126 cubes on a 128x128 atlas. Torso flap/flap2 and four chained head-flap bones add materially distinct costume geometry and animation-ready pivots.
techniqueLessons: Use two-stage parented cloth planes with opposing rotations to create a long drape that can bend without becoming a rigid slab.
Distribute the costume between torso and head contours so the three-quarter silhouette changes as one character design instead of isolated accessories.
Reserve coherent atlas regions for thin cloth surfaces and paint their edge/value hierarchy so zero-depth planes remain readable at gameplay scale.
distinctiveElementsNotToCopy: The exact Ruins Style costume silhouette and segmented head cloth
The ring motif, outfit markings, palette, and Pokémon Unite-derived visual identity

references.inspectionSummary: The inspected model has 85 bones and 102 cubes on a 128x128 atlas. Suit shells are integrated into chest, arm, leg, and head groups instead of existing as one floating costume block.
techniqueLessons: Layer slightly inflated suit shells over the primary chest mass to preserve anatomical read while creating a distinct material envelope.
Carry the theme through mirrored arm and leg volumes so the lower body participates in the transformation and motion stays parent-safe.
Use several overlapping chest cubes with different depth and UV regions to separate collar, torso shell, shoulder transition, and biological landmarks.
distinctiveElementsNotToCopy: The exact Space Style suit and helmet construction
The suit panel layout, visor treatment, palette, and Pokémon Unite-derived markings

references.inspectionSummary: The inspected model has 113 bones and 92 cubes on a 256x128 atlas. Large hood/coat shells overlap the official torso and head hierarchy, with separate arm overlays and front/back chest planes.
techniqueLessons: Build a dominant costume read from overlapping head and torso shells that share the official hierarchy instead of a detached back-frame silhouette.
Place costume UVs in a dedicated expanded-atlas region so large authored surfaces receive material detail without repainting unrelated biological texels.
Use separate arm overlays plus front/back chest planes to maintain material continuity across animation while preserving openings around face and limbs.
distinctiveElementsNotToCopy: The exact Covert Style hood, cloak profile, and garment panel layout
The original project's palette, texture markings, and recognizable covert-costume identity

reuseDecision: All three references remain STUDY_ONLY for this commercial workflow despite MIT project metadata; learn construction techniques but do not copy costume identity, geometry, UVs, texture, palette, or markings.
nextAction: Author a new Aura Sentinel concept, deterministic builder, production resolver, and professional manifest from the exact current official Cobblemon Lucario baseline. Do not reuse the rejected historical builder or model design.
